newsitem.title: USA: U.S tax preparer charged with not filing his own.
newsitem.headline: U.S tax preparer charged with not filing his own.

text.p: A Massachusetts tax return preparer was charged Friday with failing to file his own federal income tax returns for four years.

Robert Paschal, 62, of Billerica, Massachusetts, is charged with not filing tax returns on income totalling $102,000 in 1990, $107,000 in 1991, $81,000 in 1992 and $102,000 in 1993, Donald Stern, the U.S. Attorney for Massachusetts, said.
Paschal operated as a certified public accountant from his home and provided clients with various accounting services, including preparation of their tax returns, according to the federal complaint.
If he is convicted, Paschal faces up to one year in prison and a fine of up to $400,000 in addition to civil penalties and interests on any unpaid taxes.
